prompt:
Lexkite – English learning app (IELTS · TOEIC · TOEFL · CEFR) shipped in 15 UI languages incl. German, Russian, Vietnamese, Arabic (RTL): design every label for +40% longer text, wrap instead of truncating, never shrink buttons. Use the project design system (Lexkite Kit / Tactile Gamified Prep): Plus Jakarta Sans, deep teal #0F3D3E brand, coral CTA with tactile bottom ledge, cream light background, rounded 16-24px cards. App shell: mobile bottom tab bar with exactly 5 tabs Today, Vocab, Skills, Tests, Me; desktop left sidebar with the same 5 items. No hearts or lives anywhere. No photos and no drawn people: where the teacher appears, leave an empty rounded placeholder labelled "teacher-slot" (the 2D teacher Ama or Carlos is inserted by code). Material Symbols Rounded icons. Every tap target at least 44x44 px, text contrast at least 4.5:1, icons at least 3:1. Realistic content, no lorem ipsum.

Screen (mobile 390px, light theme, inner learning screen – NO bottom tab bar): "Picture match" mini-game – match each illustrated picture to its English word, built from the learner's own review words. Top bar: close X button (44px) on the left, a slim progress bar with the counter "2 / 6 pairs", and a small chip with an image icon "Picture match". Under the top bar a short instruction line in the learner's language "Chạm một ảnh rồi chạm từ đúng". Main: a 3-column x 2-row grid of 6 square picture cards (rounded 16px, white with a tactile bottom ledge); each card holds an empty rounded square placeholder labelled "pic-slot" (the illustration is inserted by code – no photos, no drawn people). Show card states: two cards already matched (pale teal tint, a small teal check badge in the corner and the matched word written under the picture), one card selected (coral 2px outline with a soft coral glow), the others idle. Below: a 2-column grid of 6 word buttons (44px+ tall, bold English words such as "umbrella", "bicycle", "volcano", "lantern", "anchor", "giraffe" in lowercase): two of them matched and faded with a check, one flashing wrong in pale coral with a small x icon, the rest idle white with beige border. A small speaker icon button on each word button to hear the word. Bottom: a secondary text button "Hint" with a lightbulb icon on the left and a primary coral tactile button "Shuffle words" pinned at the bottom full width. Friendly, calm, no timer pressure, no hearts. Quality bar (hard): every text at least 4.5:1 contrast in this theme (no light-grey or low-opacity small text, no white text on light chips); every button, link, chip, icon button and input at least 44 px tall with clear spacing; icons only from the Material Symbols set with real names; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; in the dark theme no white or very light cards or panels. Frame (Lexkite §5d): phone 390 px; top bar is one of three fixed variants – hub screen: title left + one icon action right, with the 5 bottom tabs; inner screen: back arrow (44 px) + title, no bottom tabs; lesson/focus screen: close X (44 px) top left + slim progress bar, no tabs, one full-width primary button pinned at the bottom. 16 px side gutter, one primary button per screen.

Convert this exact screen to the LIGHT theme "Bright Day" of the Lexkite Kit design system. Keep the identical layout, picture grid, word grid, components and every text string. Page background warm cream #FFF7EA, cards white #FFFFFF with soft beige borders #EADEC8 and a 3px tactile bottom ledge #D8CFBC, primary text deep teal #0F3D3E, secondary text #5A6D6C. Matched cards and words: pale teal #E3F8F5 with deep teal #12514D text and check. Selected picture card: coral #F2553B 2px outline. Wrong word: pale coral #FFEAE5 with coral #D6391F text. Keep the coral-to-amber gradient CTA with dark text #26100A (contrast 4.5:1). Remove any round profile avatar from the top bar. Text contrast at least 4.5:1, icons at least 3:1, every tap target at least 44 px.
